name: Omarchroma
author: NobleDoodle
description: True theme sync to all of your desktop applications, the easy way. Syncs your active Omarchy theme to GTK/GNOME, Qt/KDE, Dark Reader (web apps), Pear Desktop (YouTube Music), Thunderbird, Flatpak apps, additional browsers (Firefox, Zen, Floorp, Vivaldi and more) and icons (Reversal or Yaru, folders in your theme's colors), and lists the apps still on the previous theme. The syncing is done by hyprchroma, which this panel installs for you.
